summary: Runner raises ValueError when --out is an absolute path outside the repo (the xUnit wrapper's expected invocation).
fix: Wrapped args.out.relative_to(REPO_ROOT) in try/except ValueError; falls back to absolute path display.
run.py exits 2 if zero questions loaded after --limit; scoring.compute_pass([]) returns overall_passed=False.

summary: Workflow example used --input/--output (wrong CLI flags) and omitted --questions.
fix: Rewrote the workflow block to use --db/--out, separated draft + run invocations, added --questions, clarified --ir-root semantics.

summary: Stale text in Project Overview, Routing notes, and Open questions still implied original (pre-reframe) scope.
fix: Project Overview split into As-originally-scoped + As-reframed; routing-notes question-drafting bullet now says Session 3; Open questions lists three handoffs including scenarios-input.

summary: Runner did not validate question-bank schema upfront; malformed YAML and missing IR files were treated as bench data instead of exit-2 misconfiguration.
fix: Added validate_questions(): checks required fields, types, non-empty list constraints, allowed difficulty values, unique IDs, and on-disk existence of every supporting_ir_path. Returns exit code 2 on any violation.

summary: Test deleted temp output directory unconditionally in finally, destroying scores.jsonl on failure (the very artifact the assertion message pointed at).
fix: Track 'succeeded' flag; only delete outRoot when succeeded || HARVESTER_COMPREHENSION_BENCH_CLEANUP=1. On failure, log the preserved temp path to test output for diagnosis.

summary: Same outside-repo path bug as run.py — relative_to(REPO_ROOT) on the summary call would crash if --out is outside REPO_ROOT.
fix: Wrapped both relative_to(REPO_ROOT) calls in a _display() helper with try/except ValueError fallback.

summary: Drafting was still labeled as Session 2 in defaults and README despite the spec moving it to Session 3.
fix: Default --session-number changed to 3 with explanatory help; README phrased as 'Session-agnostic drafting helper (used in Session 3 ...)'.

summary: validate_questions accepted absolute, traversing, and non-file supporting_ir_paths because pathlib '/' with absolute right operand silently overrides the left.
fix: Added explicit absolute-path rejection, ir_root.resolve() basis for traversal check via Path.relative_to ValueError, and is_file() requirement.

summary: Malformed YAML, missing pyyaml, and top-level-shape errors crashed with a traceback instead of returning exit 2.
fix: Wrapped load_questions(args.questions) in try/except for any Exception; concise stderr message + exit 2 on failure.

summary: Skip paths after outRoot creation triggered the failure-diagnostic preservation path, leaking temp dirs and printing misleading messages on skipped runs.
fix: Hoisted per-DB Skip.IfNot checks above outRoot creation; tracking 'failed' (set in catch) instead of 'succeeded' so skips no longer trigger preservation.
